description: Details of Condition 9 - Housing Standards; Condition 10 - Design Code; Condition 11 - Privacy and Outlook; Condition 12 - Underpass and Access Ramp; Condition 13 - Bridge; Condition 15 (a-g) - On site Sustainability Measures; Condition 19 - Secured by Design for the Stadium and First Phase; Condition 20 - Site Wide CEMP; Condition 21 - Construction and Logistics Plan; Condition 23 - Flooding and Drainage; Condition 24 - Contamination; Condition 25 - Water Supply; Condition 26 - Bird Hazard Plan; Condition 27 - Archaeology; Condition 28 - Demolition; Condition 31 - Piling Method Statement; Condition 33 - Landscaping; Condition 34 - Tree Protection; Condition 35 - Lighting Strategy and CCTV; Condition 36 - Recycling and Refuse; Condition 41 - Accessibility Strategy; Condition 42B - Coach and Taxi Parking/Drop off Areas; Condition 43A - Cycle Parking Stadium; Condition 43B - Cycle Parking Residential Phase 1; Condition 44 - Anti-Terrorism Measures; and Condition 47 (s278 Agreement) submitted pursuant to planning permission 00703/A/P14 dated 13/12/2012 for variation of conditions 4, 6, 8,22 and 30 to: - Change of use of part of west stand at ground and first floor level from community use (D2 use) to hotel (C1 use) . Increase in the number of hotel (C1 use) bedrooms by 5 bedrooms bringing the total number of bedrooms to 165 - The expansion of the Block D hotel use (floors 1-9) into the podium upper ground floor - Removal of the hotel use from condition restricting hours of use - Removal of the hotel use from condition restricting hours of delivery - Submission of material samples of the hotel to six months post commencement of development
